name: vision_vit_timm
title: A timm ViT fine-tune with mixup/cutmix and a cosine warmup, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: timm's own train.py in miniature - create_transform, Mixup, SoftTargetCrossEntropy for the mixed batches and CrossEntropyLoss for validation

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the evaluation loaders are built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_transform() calls create_transform(is_training=False), which is resize + centre crop + normalise
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward() in every batch
the order is backward -> clip -> step
clip_grad_norm_ sits between backward() and step()
evaluate() calls model.eval() first and restores model.train()
timm.create_model with num_classes= returns a logits head, and both objectives expect logits
to_device() moves the images and the targets before every forward
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no random split: the three splits are three directories
torch.save writes state_dict() and torch.load passes map_location= and weights_only=True

gaps.what: timm appears in no knowledge table, so create_model, create_transform, Mixup, SoftTargetCrossEntropy and CosineLRScheduler all resolve to nothing: the model lane holds no model, the training loss is absent, and the stage row reports preprocess as NOT DETECTED on a program whose data path is RandAugment plus normalisation
gaps.evidence: the graph ops above at data.py:24,37,49 and finetune.py:45,58,60,61,62,99,103; `mlview analyze` reports stage preprocess present=false

gaps.what: train_transform() is drawn as a train_loop node in the Train lane and eval_transform() as an eval_loop node in the Eval lane, because the only staging signal left is the function name
gaps.evidence: NODE train_loop train data.py:22 train_transform(); NODE eval_loop eval data.py:35 eval_transform()
